Method of Attack: Supply chain attack implanting malicious code in Live Update utility
Backdoored version of ASUS Live Update downloaded and installed
Malicious manipulation via updates or other methods
Discoverer: Kaspersky Lab Global Research and Analysis Team (GReAT)
Impacted Systems: ASUS notebooks using Live Update utility
Attack Vector: Compromise of ASUS Live Update servers and software updates

Related to Winnti backdoor used by BARIUM threat actor
